Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，Both parts refer to time, so the original is redundant. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to the group of people living in that historical period, so the plural noun is needed. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，Here the mother notices or perceives the classmates’ influence; 看 means “look,” while 看到 expresses the result of seeing. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子很小的时候，This is Mengzi’s first appearance, so introduce him clearly as a child before continuing with his actions. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和妈妈搬家了，The mother was just mentioned, so repeating Mengzi’s name inside the relationship phrase is unnecessary; use the shorter reference 妈妈. [rule: redundancy_delete]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，The adverb 老是 describes a repeated habit, so the verb takes the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：因为他每天只祭拜，所以没有朋友，The intended relationship is cause and effect, so use 因为……所以…… rather than an unfinished 虽然 clause. [rule: none]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant.
This refers to the people of an era, so 人们 is required rather than generic 人.
看到 correctly expresses perceiving the result, but the remaining phrase should be 同学们对孟子有不好的影响.
孟子 is first introduced here, so introducing him before using his name is appropriate.
孟子和妈妈 avoids the awkward repeated name in 孟子和孟子妈妈 and is a valid shorter reference.
老是 marks a habitual repeated action, so it should not take completed-action 了.
The meaning is causal, and 因为……所以…… correctly links the reason and result.
